name: BatchedMesh spike (p375)
description: p375 Phase 0's spike: 2000 members of 20 geometries with one material, drawn as separate mesh entities (?bmsWay=separate), one baked merge group (baked), one BatchedMesh (batched) whose members are entities with a Transform synced each frame, or one engine batched merge group (engine, p375 Phase 1). ?bmsOrder=grouped adds them by geometry, ?bmsSort=none|range drops three's depth sort or sorts by geometry range, ?bmsCull=false drops per-member culling, ?bmsMove=0.1 moves that share of members each frame, ?bmsShadow=true turns the sun's shadow on, ?bmsCamera=inside looks along the field from its middle, ?bmsColors=true colours the batch's members by geometry, ?bmsHidden=7 hides every 7th and ?bmsBodies=kinematic gives each member a kinematic body (separate and engine), ?bmsMove moving them on fixed steps. devTools/bench/batchedMeshSpike.ts measures it.

debugData.name: BatchedMesh spike camera
debugData.description: Placed by batchedMeshSpike.ts at the load: over the whole field, or inside it (?bmsCamera=inside).
